# persistence-save

> Save-game persistence for Capacitor games: one SQLite save/load/list/delete
> API on web (jeep-sqlite over sql.js and IndexedDB) and native (SQLite with
> optional SQLCipher), with exact chained snapshot migrations, corrupt-save
> isolation, an autosave scheduler and a namespaced Preferences bridge.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/persistence-save/): guides and reference.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-save/blob/main/README.md): install,
  quick start and development.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-save/blob/main/docs/API.md):
  every export, option and error.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-save/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  modules and the invariants they protect.
- [Migrations](https://jonbogaty.com/persistence-save/migrations/): the rules for
  `N → N+1` snapshot migrations.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-save/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  orientation for coding agents.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-save/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  the local gate and review checklist.
